subject: Oryx Analytics - expanding BI projects and credential plan
messages:
From: Jordan Keller <jordan.keller@oryx-analytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expanding BI projects + credential needs

Hi Irene / Rafael —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We want to move forward and add four additional BI projects (internal dashboards + scheduled reporting) that will each require dedicated API keys and separate namespaces for consumption tracking. High level:

- 4 new projects (bi-sales, bi-ops, bi-product, bi-research)
- Rough starting throughput: ~60 req/s aggregate, peaking to ~120 req/s during ETL windows
- Need separate keys/namespaces per project
- Prefer to keep usage under our existing corporate contract but likely need an amended commit and updated term for the new capacity

Attached is a brief scope workbook that lists expected token volume by project (ORYX_scope.xlsx). Can you confirm:
1) Lead time for issuing keys and subaccounts?
2) Pricing/commit adjustment for the additional apps and whether a term extension is required?
3) Any change to SLA or support flow when we add dedicated API keys for each project?

We'd like to start onboarding one pilot project the week of Apr 5 and roll the others out over the next 6–8 weeks. Happy to jump on a quick sync to nail timelines.

Best,
Jordan
Director of Data Platform
Oryx Analytics

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Keller <jordan.keller@oryx-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expanding BI projects + credential needs

Jordan —

Appreciate the scope doc — that helps. Quick answers up front:
- Keys/subaccounts: we can spin up subaccounts and issue distinct API keys within 3 business days for the pilot once billing + SSO are confirmed; remaining projects we can queue in batches of 2 per week.
- Pricing: Ben will follow up with a proposal for an incremental commit and term adjustment; we typically handle additional project commitments as an amendment and can align term end-dates with your current contract to simplify renewal cadence.
- SLA/support: No SLA change for adding keys; however, if you want a Dedicated pool or higher throughput guarantees we can add reserved capacity (that would require a commit and a slightly different support routing).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ben to send a mutual-action-plan PDF with proposed commit and timeline.
2) Rafael (solutions) to confirm recommended key namespaces and technical onboarding checklist.
3) Jordan to confirm the pilot project and a billing contact for the amendment.

I'm attaching our subaccount guide for reference.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Subaccount-Guide.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Keller <jordan.keller@oryx-analytics.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: Oryx expansion — commit & rollout plan

Jordan — Irene —

Following up with a compact proposal so we can keep your Apr 5 pilot date: key points below and attached is a one-page MAP (Oryx-MAP-v2.pdf) that outlines responsibilities and dates.

Proposal summary:
- New items: 4 project namespaces, 1 key per project (with the option to add secondary keys per app)
- Throughput sizing: we’re sizing for the 120 req/s peak across projects; current hosted pool can absorb pilot load. If you want dedicated latency SLOs for peak windows we recommend a small Dedicated reserve for those ETL windows (Ben can send numbers).
- Pricing/term: add an incremental commit for the additional projects priced at a 25% uplift from your current unit price with an 18-month amendment that aligns with your main contract end date (this keeps renewals synchronized).
- Discounts: 10% additional for committing to the 18-month extension and the full expected volume across the four projects.

Timeline (recommended):
- Mar 23: Sign MAP + billing contact confirmed
- Mar 24–26: Subaccount & keys provisioned for pilot (bi-sales)
- Apr 5: Pilot onboarding (bi-sales)
- Apr 12–May 28: Staggered rollout for remaining 3 projects (2 per week)

Action items for Oryx:
- Provide billing contact and purchase order reference
- Confirm pilot project (we'll provision keys once PO or billing ok is received)

Attachments: Oryx-MAP-v2.pdf (mutual action plan)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ORYX-2027-014

If that looks reasonable I can route the amendment and DocuSign next week. Rafael / Marissa — can you add the recommended key namespace pattern below?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Keller <jordan.keller@oryx-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@oryx-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Oryx expansion — commit & rollout plan

Ben / Irene —

This looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. We can confirm pilot = bi-sales. Elaine will be the billing contact (elaine@oryx-analytics.com). Please send the MAP and amendment for signature; we authorize provisioning once the PO reference and DocuSign have been exchanged.

Also, small ask re: naming convention — please add a short prefix for environment (prod/staging) in the key namespace so our pipeline can auto-route. Something like: oryx_prod_bi-sales / oryx_stg_bi-sales would work.

We'll expect the pilot key provision by Mar 26. Thanks for moving quickly.

Jordan
Director of Data Platform
Oryx Analytics
